title: CHAPTER TWENTY. Christian warfare: enemies
pass_a_gloss: Pass A clause gloss (reordered): God's enemies toward be distinguished: Satan from ye beginning; ye world following its prince and hating God and His friends; our flesh opposed toward God and His Spirit. — Christian warfare stands as believers' spiritual fight against ye enemies belonging toward salvation under Christ ye captain. — CHAPTER TWENTY. On Christian warfare and ye cross.
pass_b_english: CHAPTER TWENTY. On Christian warfare and the cross.
Christian warfare is believers' spiritual fight against the enemies of salvation under Christ the captain.
God's enemies to be distinguished: Satan from the beginning; the world following its prince and hating God and His friends; our flesh opposed to God and His Spirit.
source_text: CAPUT VIGESIMUM, De militia et cruce Christiana. Militia Christiana est pugna spiritualis fidelium adversus hostes salutis sub duce Christo. II. Discernendi Dei hostes: IV. Satan est hostis Dei inde a principio. IV. Mundus principem suum secutus Deo et amicis Dei inimicatur (James 4:4; John 15:18-19). V. Caro nostra Deo et Spiritui eius adversa est (Gal. 5:16-17; Rom. 8:5-7).
